support_spans: High titer of cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody

concepts.why: The patient's imaging findings of white matter changes are consistent with CNS vasculitis, but the absence of evidence of vasculitis on pathological examination makes this diagnosis less likely.

The patient's symptoms of aphasia, confusion, and weakness, as well as the presence of oligoclonal bands in the CSF, are consistent with an inflammatory demyelinating disease, but the clinical presentation is not typical for ADEM.
